Since 2026-10-05 the castle and its voice caption stop drawing under the room's story clips (owner answer QP-3): d1_pool_clean measures 2.02 mean layers with three drawn items, down from 3.39 and 21. Roshan keeps her colours under the declared room tint (GS-17). Scored 1 only because the OD2 look-alike review at phone size with the HUD is not recorded yet (capture: Codex P1); her work still uses one approved directional cutout, not authored action frames (Codex P2).

C8.note: Every touch answers at once (queued taps pop bubbles, a retargeted lane moves Roshan); pieces fly into the one basket with a clean ring; no spoken line names the wrong object; the clean-pool reveal is earned by finishing and plays out (light returns, rainbow waterfall, healthy fountain and the completion line; 2.4-5.6 s from the finale's start) before the room-completion clip takes the screen, so the clip no longer freezes a line mid-word (MA-PLAY-006, GS-21). C10.note: probe_day_one_pool_cleanup completes all three activities with real touches, strokes, taps and pulls, with thirty-second zero-input, retarget, queue, second-finger, focus-loss and teardown legs, and since 2026-10-04 checks one room basket, the quiet ambient group, approved ripple art and the held reward beat, and since 2026-10-05 that the room stages no Rumi before the clip that owns her rise; probe_day_one_story_clips checks that the castle and its caption stop drawing under a clip and return after it; probe_day_one_castle_dressing, probe_castle_pool_life_2d, probe_living_world and probe_interaction guard the shared layers.
